sloka: कदा शोणितदिग्धाङ्गम् दीपैः कार्मुकविच्युतैः ।शरैरादीपयिष्यामि उल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम् ॥६-२४-३९॥।।
transliteration: kadā śoṇitadigdhāṅgam dīpaiḥ kārmukavicyutaiḥ ।śarairādīpayiṣyāmi ulkābhiriva kuñjaram ॥6-24-39॥।।

translations.english: "When will the glowing arrows from my quiver, that are fit to pierce in thousands, be able to goad Rama like the burning fire sticks goad the elephants?"
